description: A taxonomy tagging policy defines the classification system for all content: vocabulary type, per-content-type tag count rules, normalization, and prohibited terms — enforced before any content can be tagged.

rules.description: A taxonomy-policy.spec.json file must exist and be valid JSON with vocabularyType and contentTypes fields.
vocabularyType must be one of 'controlled', 'free-form', or 'hybrid'. Undeclared or arbitrary values make enforcement impossible.
When vocabularyType is 'controlled', spec.vocabulary must be a non-empty array of tags each with a unique id and a label.
Every content type in spec.contentTypes must define minTags and maxTags. Missing rules mean tags are applied without any count enforcement.
minTags and maxTags must be non-negative numbers, and min must be <= max. String values like 'a few' are not enforceable.
spec.normalization must declare rules for 'case', 'specialChars', and 'whitespace'. Incomplete normalization causes taxonomy drift via spelling variants.
spec.prohibitedTags must be explicitly present (even as an empty array). Absent key means unknown policy — not 'no prohibited tags'.
